options.text: Assign each requester to check separately; use the label even if a seal is damaged.
options.zh: 請每位提出需求的人各自核對；封條損壞仍以箱標為準。
options.whyZh: 只須安排一名代表核對，且封條受損時不能直接採用箱標數量。

options.text: Send one representative to check with warehouse staff; use the label count only when the seal is intact.
options.zh: 安排一位代表和庫房核對；只有封條完好才採用箱標數量。
options.whyZh: 組長指定一人與庫房核對。封條完整的箱子可用標示數量，封條受損者不可直接照箱標。

options.text: Assign one representative to check with warehouse staff; use all label counts, including boxes with broken seals.
options.zh: 安排一位代表和庫房核對；所有箱子都照箱標，包括封條破損的箱子。
options.whyZh: 人員分工正確，但不能把破損封條的箱標直接當成正確數量。

options.text: Send separate representatives for each box and verify only counts that already match their labels.
options.zh: 每箱各派一位代表，只核對與箱標已相符的數量。
options.whyZh: 不是每箱各派人；也不能把核對範圍限於看似相符的箱標。

group.title: Inventory counting notice
group.passage: The warehouse will conduct its quarterly inventory count on Friday afternoon. Material requests needed for Friday's production must reach us by eleven in the morning. From noon to four, we will handle safety emergencies only. Team leaders should assign one person to confirm quantities with warehouse staff. For sealed boxes, use the quantity on the label unless the seal is damaged. Regular material pickup starts again at four thirty in the afternoon.
group.passageZh: 倉庫將在星期五下午進行季度盤點。星期五生產所需的領料申請必須在上午十一點前送達。中午到下午四點，只處理緊急安全事件。各組主管應指派一人與倉庫人員核對數量。有封條的紙箱，若封條未破損，請依標籤上的數量盤點。下午四點半恢復正常領料。
